card.title: STORM DIVISION
card.text: Your other Japanese units have +2 attack.
card.flavorText: The 116th Division, known as the "Storm Division," was formed in Kyoto in May 1938 from the headquarters of the 16th Division. It was classified as a B-class square division and initially assigned to the Central China Expeditionary Army. After landing in Shanghai in June, it advanced through Anqing to take part in the Battle of Wuhan. Elements of the division later fought at Nanchang in early 1939. Following the Doolittle Raid in 1942, the division was involved in the Zhejiang-Jiangxi campaign. That same year, it was reorganized as a triangular division after the transfer of its 138th Infantry Regiment. It took part in the Battle of Changde in 1943 and was heavily engaged during the Battle of Changsha in 1944. As part of Operation Ichi-Go, the Storm Division participated in the prolonged siege of Hengyang, where it suffered major losses during a 40-day assault before capturing the city. In 1945, it took part in the Battle of West Henan–North Hubei with the support of the 86th Independent Mixed Brigade. The division was stationed in Hengyang when Japan surrendered in August 1945.
